title: Black Friday Video Ads From One Photo | AIVideosUGC
description: Create Black Friday video ads from a single product photo and add your discount in your editor. Get a 9:16 or 1:1 clip for Facebook and Instagram today.
h1: Black Friday Video Ads Ready for Your Deal
lead: Black Friday video ads start with a bold product clip made before the sale rush. Upload a photo, describe a striking scene, then add your discount, dates, and countdown in your own editor.
intro: Your Black Friday offer needs a strong picture to sit on, and that's what this clip gives you. The sample shows a silver folding e-bike with fat tires standing on a city plaza at golden hour, with glass towers glowing behind it.

The video supplies the moving picture, and you add the deal. You lay prices, percentages, dates, and countdown timers on yourself in CapCut or Ads Manager, so every number is right and easy to change. Make your clips early, then drop in the offer when it's final. It suits bigger-ticket items like bikes, electronics, and appliances.
tip: Leave space for your offer by describing an open area beside the product, like "e-bike on the right, empty plaza and sky on the left."

steps.d: Pick the product you're discounting and use a sharp photo with the whole item in view.
Golden hour downtown, neon streets, or a dark studio with one spotlight. Go vertical for Stories or square for feeds.
Layer the discount, sale dates, and a countdown on top using Canva or Ads Manager.

ideas.d: Make a second clip with a night-city or neon look to keep the sale going into Monday.
Share a 6-second clip with your email list a week ahead, with "coming soon" added in your editor.
Run the same idea for smaller items like earbuds or smart lights, set on a festive gift table.

faq.q: Can the video show my discount and a countdown?
faq.a: Add them yourself after downloading. Prices, dates, and timers made by AI can be wrong, so type them in your editor, where you can also update them if the deal changes.

faq.q: How far ahead should I make Black Friday videos?
faq.a: A few weeks ahead is a good idea. Get the clips done while things are calm, then add the final numbers once you've settled on them.

faq.q: Can I show the same product in different scenes?
faq.a: Yes. Each video is a separate run, so you can make a city version, a studio version, and a snowy one, with the credit cost shown up front each time.

faq.q: When should I add Black Friday prices?
faq.a: Add the exact price, discount, and countdown after download in Canva, CapCut, or Ads Manager. This keeps every number editable and correct as the offer changes.
